title: Blend modes on text
text: Every mode on an embedded-font text field over coloured shapes, placed plainly, at fractional positions, rotated, scaled, at half alpha, in a sprite and in a LAYER. Glyph edges differ between rasterisers, so each cell is scored against the mode's formula applied to the renderer's own plain text.
notes: ADD and SUBTRACT glyph edges differ from the formula by 2 to 4% on every OpenFL renderer: Flash mixes an edge pixel's backdrop with the clipped blend result by coverage, the renderers clip the coverage-weighted sum.
